speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for your detailed history. To better understand your condition, could you describe how easy it is for you to bruise, and have you noticed any other symptoms like excessive bleeding from cuts or nosebleeds? Additionally, have you ever experienced bleeding after minor dental procedures or surgeries?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency). Given the family history of affected male relatives (uncle), joint swelling, and severe post-extraction bleeding unresponsive to local measures, this strongly suggests an X-linked bleeding disorder. I recommend immediate confirmation with a Factor VIII activity level assay and a Complete Blood Count (CBC) to rule out thrombocytopenia. REQUEST TEST: Factor VIII Activity, CBC, PT, PTT.
